verdict.rationale: Brave's docs describe date-based filtering. This includes recency presets such as Last 24 Hours (`pd`) and custom date ranges like `2022-04-01to2022-07-30`. The docs also claim an independent index of billions of pages crawled for fresh results, plus real-time news. missing for 10: no documented crawl or update frequency or index-latency figures, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of result freshness.
